summary: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten debt offering by its Dutch finance subsidiaries, guaranteed by the parent. Teva Finance II priced €1.0B 4.250% senior notes due 2033 at 98.756 and €500M 4.625% notes due 2036 at 98.327; Teva Finance III priced $1.0B 5.500% notes due 2034 and $1.0B 5.750% notes due 2037; Teva Finance IV priced $1.2B 5.250% notes due 2032. Underwriters include BNP, Citi, Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan; closing expected September 16, 2026. This is a routine capital-markets takedown, not a special situation.
